title: "06_all_pathways_cascade_violin"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Pathway Validation: Cascade Violin Plots (FN1 / CCL / ApoE)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Description:
#   Generates a combined, multi-pathway violin-plot figure validating
#   ligand-receptor signaling activity in microglia states. For each pathway
#   (FN1, CCL, ApoE), mean per-cell expression of the ligand and receptor
#   gene sets is compared across three groups:
#     1. Homeostatic microglia      (States 1-2, pooled across conditions)
#     2. Target disease state       (pathway-specific state, disease condition
#                                     only)
#     3. Other cell types           (all non-microglial populations, disease
#                                     condition only)
#
#   Ligand and receptor panels are stacked per pathway (Ligands on top,
#   Receptors below), and all three pathways are combined into a single
#   vertically stacked PDF figure.
#
# Inputs:
#   - MAY.merge.obj.final.obj.final.obj.Rdata  (merged Seurat object: all cell
#     types, all conditions)
#   - MAY.MG.recluster.obj.Rdata               (microglia-only Seurat object)
#
# Output:
#   - figures/Validation_all_pathways_cascade_violin.pdf
# =============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(patchwork)
})

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# 1. Configuration
# =============================================================================

config <- list(
  
  # -- File paths --------------------------------------------------------
  merge_obj_path = "/projects/ecbl/DTRA/INTEGRATE/May_data/MAY.merge.obj.final.obj.final.obj.Rdata",
  mg_obj_path    = "/projects/ecbl/DTRA/INTEGRATE/May_data/MAY.MG.recluster.obj.Rdata",
  output_dir     = "figures",
  output_file    = "Validation_all_pathways_cascade_violin.pdf",
  
  # -- Data schema ---------------------------------------------------------
  assay          = "RNA",
  state_col      = "state_anno",     # microglia state metadata column
  celltype_col   = "annotation3",    # cell-type metadata column (merged object)
  condition_col  = "orig.ident",     # sample/condition metadata column
  homeo_states   = c("State1", "State2"),
  all_mg_states  = c("State1", "State2", "State3", "State4", "State5"),
  
  # -- Cell types to display in the "other cell types" panel section ------
  celltype_order = c("Excitatory_Neurons", "Inhibitory_Neurons", "Astrocytes",
                     "Endothelial_Cells", "OPCs", "Oligodendrocytes",
                     "Pericytes", "Myeloid", "Lymphoid")
)

# -- Pathway definitions: colour, disease condition, target state, gene sets --
pathway_defs <- list(
  
  FN1 = list(
    color        = "#C75B4E",
    target_state = "State3",
    disease_id   = "OPNA_GD_24h",
    control_id   = "OPNA_Control_24h",
    disease_lab  = "OPNA",
    ligands      = c("Fn1", "Thbs1", "Ibsp"),
    receptors    = c("Itgav", "Itgb3", "Itga5", "Itgb1", "Cd44")
  ),
  
  CCL = list(
    color        = "#1D9E75",
    target_state = "State4",
    disease_id   = "VEEV_VEEV_7d",
    control_id   = "VEEV_Mock_7d",
    disease_lab  = "VEEV",
    ligands      = c("Ccl2", "Ccl3", "Ccl4", "Ccl5"),
    receptors    = c("Ccr1", "Ccr2", "Ccr5")
  ),
  
  ApoE = list(
    color        = "#534AB7",
    target_state = "State5",
    disease_id   = "TBI_CCI_7d",
    control_id   = "TBI_Sham_7d",
    disease_lab  = "TBI",
    ligands      = c("Apoe", "Apoc1"),
    receptors    = c("Trem2", "Lrp1", "Tyrobp")
  )
)

# =============================================================================
# 2. Helper functions
# =============================================================================

#' Load the merged and microglia-recluster Seurat objects and harmonize
#' microglia state labels onto the merged object.
#'
#' @param cfg Named list of configuration parameters (see `config`).
#' @return A list with `merged` (merged Seurat object, states transferred and
#'   collapsed to "Microglia") and `mg` (microglia-only Seurat object).
load_and_prepare_objects <- function(cfg) {
  
  merge_env <- new.env()
  load(cfg$merge_obj_path, envir = merge_env)
  mg_env <- new.env()
  load(cfg$mg_obj_path, envir = mg_env)
  
  merged <- get(ls(merge_env)[1], envir = merge_env)
  mg     <- get(ls(mg_env)[1], envir = mg_env)
  
  # Transfer microglia state labels onto the merged object
  mg_state_labels <- setNames(mg[[cfg$state_col, drop = TRUE]], colnames(mg))
  shared_cells    <- intersect(colnames(merged), names(mg_state_labels))
  
  collapsed_col <- paste0(cfg$celltype_col, "_collapsed")
  merged[[cfg$celltype_col]][shared_cells, ] <- mg_state_labels[shared_cells]
  merged[[collapsed_col]] <- merged[[cfg$celltype_col]]
  
  mg_mask <- merged[[collapsed_col, drop = TRUE]] %in% cfg$all_mg_states
  merged[[collapsed_col]][mg_mask, ] <- "Microglia"
  
  DefaultAssay(merged) <- cfg$assay
  DefaultAssay(mg)     <- cfg$assay
  
  list(merged = merged, mg = mg, collapsed_col = collapsed_col)
}

#' Identify the homeostatic, target-state, and other-cell-type cell subsets
#' for a single pathway.
#'
#' @param def Pathway definition (element of `pathway_defs`).
#' @param objs Output of `load_and_prepare_objects()`.
#' @param cfg Configuration list.
#' @return A list of cell barcodes per group, plus the ordered vector of
#'   "other" cell-type names present in the data.
build_cell_groups <- function(def, objs, cfg) {
  
  mg_states_vec <- objs$mg[[cfg$state_col, drop = TRUE]]
  mg_cond_vec   <- objs$mg[[cfg$condition_col, drop = TRUE]]
  
  mg_cells_homeo  <- colnames(objs$mg)[mg_states_vec %in% cfg$homeo_states]
  mg_cells_target <- colnames(objs$mg)[
    mg_states_vec == def$target_state & mg_cond_vec == def$disease_id
  ]
  
  merged_ct_vec   <- objs$merged[[objs$collapsed_col, drop = TRUE]]
  merged_cond_vec <- objs$merged[[cfg$condition_col, drop = TRUE]]
  
  other_cells_list <- lapply(cfg$celltype_order, function(ct) {
    cells <- colnames(objs$merged)[
      merged_ct_vec == ct & merged_cond_vec == def$disease_id
    ]
    if (length(cells) == 0) return(NULL)
    list(cells = cells, cell_type = ct)
  })
  other_cells_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), other_cells_list)
  
  list(
    mg_cells_homeo   = mg_cells_homeo,
    mg_cells_target  = mg_cells_target,
    other_cells_list = other_cells_list,
    other_ct         = vapply(other_cells_list, `[[`, character(1), "cell_type")
  )
}

#' Compute per-cell mean expression of a gene set for every group, returning a
#' tidy data frame ready for plotting.
#'
#' @param genes Character vector of gene symbols.
#' @param groups Output of `build_cell_groups()`.
#' @param target_state Name of the pathway's target disease state.
#' @param objs Output of `load_and_prepare_objects()`.
#' @param cfg Configuration list.
#' @return A data frame with columns `group` (factor) and `mean_exp`.
build_expression_df <- function(genes, groups, target_state, objs, cfg) {
  
  mean_expr_for_cells <- function(seurat_obj, genes, cells) {
    g_use <- genes[genes %in% rownames(seurat_obj)]
    if (length(g_use) == 0 || length(cells) == 0) return(NULL)
    expr <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = cfg$assay,
                                   layer = "data")[g_use, cells, drop = FALSE])
    if (nrow(expr) == 1) expr[1, ] else colMeans(expr)
  }
  
  rows <- list()
  
  homeo_expr <- mean_expr_for_cells(objs$mg, genes, groups$mg_cells_homeo)
  if (!is.null(homeo_expr)) {
    rows[["Homeostatic"]] <- data.frame(group = "Homeostatic",
                                        mean_exp = as.numeric(homeo_expr))
  }
  
  target_expr <- mean_expr_for_cells(objs$mg, genes, groups$mg_cells_target)
  if (!is.null(target_expr)) {
    rows[[target_state]] <- data.frame(group = target_state,
                                       mean_exp = as.numeric(target_expr))
  }
  
  for (item in groups$other_cells_list) {
    ct_expr <- mean_expr_for_cells(objs$merged, genes, item$cells)
    if (!is.null(ct_expr)) {
      rows[[item$cell_type]] <- data.frame(group = item$cell_type,
                                           mean_exp = as.numeric(ct_expr))
    }
  }
  
  group_levels <- c("Homeostatic", target_state, groups$other_ct)
  df <- bind_rows(rows)
  df$group <- factor(df$group, levels = group_levels)
  df
}

#' Build a single violin + boxplot panel for one gene set / group set.
#'
#' @param df Data frame from `build_expression_df()`.
#' @param title Panel title.
#' @param highlight_color Hex colour used for the target-state fill/title.
#' @param group_levels Ordered group factor levels.
#' @param target_state Name of the target disease state (relabeled on the
#'   x-axis as "Disease State").
#' @param show_x_labels Whether to draw x-axis tick labels (used only for the
#'   final panel in the combined figure).
#' @return A ggplot object.
make_violin_panel <- function(df, title, highlight_color, group_levels,
                              target_state, show_x_labels = FALSE) {
  
  n_other <- length(group_levels) - 2
  
  fill_colors  <- setNames(c("grey70", highlight_color, rep("grey85", n_other)),
                           group_levels)
  label_colors <- setNames(c("grey40", highlight_color, rep("grey40", n_other)),
                           group_levels)
  label_face   <- setNames(c("plain", "bold", rep("plain", n_other)),
                           group_levels)
  
  x_labels <- setNames(group_levels, group_levels)
  x_labels[target_state] <- "Disease State"
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = mean_exp, fill = group)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.85, trim = TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.08, outlier.size = 0,
                 color = "grey30", fill = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Mean expression") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold",
                                  color = highlight_color, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18)
    )
  
  if (show_x_labels) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                                 color = label_colors[group_levels],
                                 face  = label_face[group_levels])
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  }
  
  p
}

#' Build the ligand and receptor panels for a single pathway.
#'
#' @param pathway_name Name of the pathway (e.g. "FN1").
#' @param def Pathway definition.
#' @param objs Output of `load_and_prepare_objects()`.
#' @param cfg Configuration list.
#' @param show_x_on_receptors Whether the receptor panel should show x-axis
#'   labels (true only for the last pathway in the combined figure).
#' @return A named list with `lig` and `rec` ggplot panels (either may be
#'   `NULL` if no cells/genes were available).
build_pathway_panels <- function(pathway_name, def, objs, cfg,
                                 show_x_on_receptors = FALSE) {
  
  target_state <- def$target_state
  message(sprintf("Building panels: %s -> %s", pathway_name, target_state))
  
  groups <- build_cell_groups(def, objs, cfg)
  message(sprintf("  Homeostatic cells: %d | Target (%s): %d",
                  length(groups$mg_cells_homeo), target_state,
                  length(groups$mg_cells_target)))
  
  group_levels <- c("Homeostatic", target_state, groups$other_ct)
  
  df_lig <- build_expression_df(def$ligands, groups, target_state, objs, cfg)
  panel_lig <- if (nrow(df_lig) > 0) {
    make_violin_panel(df_lig, title = paste("Ligands -", pathway_name),
                      highlight_color = def$color, group_levels = group_levels,
                      target_state = target_state, show_x_labels = FALSE)
  } else NULL
  
  df_rec <- build_expression_df(def$receptors, groups, target_state, objs, cfg)
  panel_rec <- if (nrow(df_rec) > 0) {
    make_violin_panel(df_rec, title = paste("Receptors -", pathway_name),
                      highlight_color = def$color, group_levels = group_levels,
                      target_state = target_state,
                      show_x_labels = show_x_on_receptors)
  } else NULL
  
  list(lig = panel_lig, rec = panel_rec)
}

# =============================================================================
# 3. Main
# =============================================================================

main <- function(cfg, pathway_defs) {
  
  dir.create(cfg$output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  objs <- load_and_prepare_objects(cfg)
  
  pw_names   <- names(pathway_defs)
  n_pathways <- length(pw_names)
  all_panels <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(pw_names)) {
    pw  <- pw_names[[i]]
    def <- pathway_defs[[pw]]
    
    panels <- build_pathway_panels(
      pathway_name         = pw,
      def                  = def,
      objs                 = objs,
      cfg                  = cfg,
      show_x_on_receptors  = (i == n_pathways)
    )
    
    if (!is.null(panels$lig)) all_panels[[paste0(pw, "_lig")]] <- panels$lig
    if (!is.null(panels$rec)) all_panels[[paste0(pw, "_rec")]] <- panels$rec
  }
  
  n_panels <- length(all_panels)
  if (n_panels == 0) stop("No panels could be built -- check input data and pathway definitions.")
  
  combined <- wrap_plots(all_panels, ncol = 1, heights = rep(1, n_panels))
  
  max_groups  <- max(vapply(pathway_defs, function(def) 2 + length(cfg$celltype_order),
                            numeric(1)))
  output_path <- file.path(cfg$output_dir, cfg$output_file)
  
  pdf(output_path,
      width  = max(8, max_groups * 0.5 + 3),
      height = n_panels * 3)
  print(combined)
  dev.off()
  
  message("Saved: ", output_path)
  invisible(combined)
}

if (sys.nframe() == 0) {
  main(config, pathway_defs)
}
```
